spans.text: If any required stage is missing, if either string under a stage is absent, or if a value is not a string, validation stops before the pipeline starts and reports the failing field.
spans.note: The prompt demonstrates good tool/action safety practices. It includes validation before pipeline execution, requiring all stages to be present and properly formatted before the pipeline starts. It enforces structural integrity checks and reports failing fields, preventing execution with incomplete or malformed configurations.
